verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the MCP docs' mention of asking about "flag/decline reasons" and which policy applies, which implies Navan declines some transactions against policy. Navan also advertises "unlimited policy and approval workflows." Nothing documents how card controls are configured. Missing for 10: documented per-card restrictions by merchant category, by specific merchant, and by amount limit; explicit point-of-sale auto-decline or card auto-lock behavior; independent or hands-on corroboration.
